title: Chapter 2670 - 76: Marching Toward "Death" (Part 3)
content:
Chapter 2670: Chapter 76: Marching Toward "Death" (Part 3)

Dan Zhu shut his mouth.

But Bi Jie, being highly suspicious, turned his head and found it strange when he saw Dan Zhu not moving.

The Danque Tribe wanted to compete with him to enter the Stone Palace.

But now that the Stone Palace was open, why were these Danque Tribe People so quiet?

The more Bi Jie thought, the more he felt there was something suspicious.

He suddenly said, "Wait!"

The people of the Bi Fang Tribe stopped, and Bi Jie also stood still, pondering for a moment, and then said, "Don’t rush in, stay outside. I..."

Bi Jie was about to say, "I will take a few elders in..."

But as the words were on his lips, he suddenly hesitated.

The Danque Tribe harbored murderous intent toward him, encircling him from outside, and the inside of the Stone Palace was unknown.

As the Young Master, if he rashly entered the Stone Palace and encountered an incident, he might end up caught between two fires, with slim chances of survival.

Bi Jie then named two elders, "Elder Cang, Elder Zhuo, you take a team inside to investigate the reality."

Elder Cang was short and stocky, Elder Zhuo was thin, both were Golden Cores, with extraordinary cultivation.

The two cupped their hands and said:

"Yes, Young Master."

After speaking, Elder Cang and Elder Zhuo of the Bi Fang Tribe led a team of more than twenty Barbarian Soldiers straight through the stone gate and into the dark Stone Palace of the Shugubu.

Bi Jie, on the other hand, led the main force to stand guard outside the Stone Palace, wary of the Danque Tribe people.

Mo Hua felt a sense of regret in his heart.

If this Bi Jie personally led all the Golden Cores of the Bi Fang Tribe into this Stone Palace with the Evil God’s aura, that would have been interesting.

What a pity, this Bi Jie was too cautious.

Ba Shan looked left and right, feeling a bit anxious, and asked, "Gentleman, should we also rush in and take a look now?"

The Danque Tribe People were likely imprisoned in this Stone Palace.

And the Bi Fang Tribe had such a fixation on this Stone Palace, there must be good things inside.

However, Mo Hua decisively said, "No."

Dan Zhu was a bit puzzled: "Gentleman, in this Stone Palace..."

Mo Hua shook his head, "I can’t say now, you’ll know in a moment."

Dan Zhu and the others exchanged glances.

But with Mo Hua’s instructions, they didn’t act rashly and quietly stood guard outside the Stone Palace, subtly confronting the Bi Fang Tribe.

The sunlight shone on the cliff, casting a shadow.

Everyone waited like this, as time slowly passed.

Soon, the coolness of the mountains turned into a slight irritation, making people uncomfortable.

Ever since the two Golden Cores of the Bi Fang Tribe, along with twenty Barbarian Soldiers, entered the Stone Palace, it was as if they had vanished into thin air, with no response even after two hours.

The Young Master of the Bi Fang Tribe, Bi Jie, grew restless.

Everyone couldn’t help but start discussing.

Another 30 minutes passed, and suddenly footsteps echoed from the dark Stone Palace, and a figure slowly walked out.

The figure seemed somewhat familiar.

It was the short and stocky Elder Cang who had just entered the Stone Palace.

The eager Bi Jie hurriedly asked, "Elder Cang, what happened, why the delay..."

Before he could finish speaking, his expression instantly changed dramatically.

At this moment, Elder Cang had reached the doorway of the Stone Palace; the sunlight shining down revealed Elder Cang’s appearance to everyone.

The flesh on his thigh was torn away, leaving only white bone.

Half of his face had been gnawed off.

There was a large hole in his chest, with the organs nearly hollowed out.

It was a tragic sight.

All the Barbarian Cultivators present, whether from the Bi Fang Tribe or the Danque Tribe, turned pale.

Sounds of gasping arose one after another.

They were tribal cultivators, most of whom had experienced battles and were not unaccustomed to bloodier and more violent scenes.

But those scenes were casualties caused by direct combat.

Completely different from the eerie and creepy feeling of this moment.

Even Mo Hua felt a slight shiver in his heart.

He knew that the Stone Palace should house a ferocious Evil God, and these people entering unprepared were likely to suffer, facing some hardship.

But Mo Hua hadn’t expected the Evil God to be this ’ferocious’...

Mo Hua slightly frowned.

Bi Jie was filled with horror and urgently asked, "Elder Cang, what happened exactly?!"

But he only dared to ask from a distance, not daring to step forward.

Elder Cang’s bloody and exposed state carried an inexplicable eerie aura, his face a blend of terror and despair, and he said with a cracked smile:

"All dead..."

"All eating..."

"I... killed Elder Zhuo because he wanted to eat me, and I also ate him..."

As Elder Cang spoke, he felt his life force rapidly fading, wanting to activate his Magic Treasure for protection, but as soon as he tried, his jade bracelet Magic Treasure showed mottled stains, seemingly corrupted.

Bi Jie stood stunned.

Elder Cang let out a bitter smile, knowing his end was near, heaving a sigh and solemnly speaking to Bi Jie:

"Inside the Stone Palace, there is a great evil... Young Master, take care..."

Before he finished speaking, his Magic Treasure dimmed, and Elder Cang died.

Bi Jie’s face turned pale.

The entire scene was deathly silent, after which came a wave of panic and uproar.

A Golden Core Elder had just died like that.

Moreover, died in such an unclear manner, with such a horrifying death...

They didn’t even know what exactly had happened.

In the midst of this commotion, Mo Hua’s gaze shifted slightly, suddenly looking at Chi Feng nearby, and he gestured towards Bi Jie across him, softly asked:

"Can we kill him?"

Chi Feng was startled, then instantly understood.

Now, the Bi Fang Tribe had lost two Golden Cores and twenty elite Barbarian Soldiers in this inexplicable Stone Palace, greatly diminishing their strength.

The Danque Tribe, however, had suffered no losses. At this moment, with weak enemies and strong allies, if they suddenly launched a surprise attack, they might actually threaten this gifted and ruthless Young Master of the Bi Fang Tribe—Bi Jie.
